name: truckify-backend
description: Truckify REST API - event-based food truck booking platform (Node.js + Express + SQLite/PostgreSQL schema)

comments.database: Uses Node's built-in SQLite driver (node:sqlite) so there is zero native build step. For PostgreSQL, run /database/schema.postgres.sql, add `pg`, and replace src/db/index.js - the SQL is already PostgreSQL-compatible.
